what: REC-1 R3b acceptance: the recorder's inclusive main-thread cost, software VP9 960x540 at 6 fps (the test machines' rung), recorder on minus paused in place, at a fixed pose, as a duet (both arms in one run, interleaved on/off/off/on)
amended: 2026-10-25, coordinator ruling (1) after 261025-043054-e104 met the exclusive class's 30-minute ceiling: the same 108 pairs, as two exclusive tickets of 54 pairs, pooled. e104's partial windows are incomplete, never read and excluded

exclusion.median: each ticket's own: the median of that ticket's judged windows, both arms pooled

verdict: met if the pooled paired 95% interval's upper end is under budgetMs; not met if its lower end is over it; otherwise inconclusive. Exactly the first 54 pairs of each ticket are judged; the unexcluded interval and each ticket's own estimate are reported beside the pooled one. Pooled regardless of agreement between the tickets: no consistency gate
pooling: only when both tickets are complete (54 pairs each) and neither was stopped; both at the same commit, the same prebuilt build (its content hash) and the same machine, submitted back to back
rerun: a ticket that ends incomplete, or that heavy-check labels DISTURBED, is rerun once, alone, under this declaration; if the rerun fails too, the result is 'no verdict'. No third try, and no change of design after seeing data

ceiling.rule: duet.sh refuses a declaration whose ticket time, (pairsPerTicket x 2 x windowS + startupS) x (1 + marginPct/100), exceeds ceilingS

power: planned for a true cost of 0.10 ms/frame with a pair-difference sd of 0.20 ms (measured: 0.159-0.176 recorder off in both arms after the host's CPU isolation, run 261025-014714-dfd1; 0.184 and 0.205 on/off before it): 96 pairs give about 90% chance of 'met'; 108 leave room for about 10% of pairs excluded
exclusionReason: slow windows (+0.6 to +1.8 ms for 10-25 s) recur with no recorder at all (261025-014714-dfd1: recorder off throughout, the VM otherwise quiet, about 280-290 s apart, matching the host's job-matcher bursts of about 4 min 45 s) and hit paused windows as often as recording ones (261024-231132-692c, 261024-203711-5c1c). A pair is dropped as a whole when either of its windows is more than 0.6 ms over its ticket's median of every judged window, both arms pooled, so both arms lose the same time
seat: exclusive on the RTX 3090 (factory-worker), from a build made beforehand by another job (exclusive windows never compile); the single-ticket form was rehearsed on the RTX 4070 Laptop (261025-033553-5fd5, indicative)
